name: Canberra Museum and Gallery
objection: A modest regional museum; temporary exhibitions are not a lasting draw.

name: Glebe Park
objection: Run rule rejects urban parks no guide singles out; Wikivoyage does single it out but only in one sentence.

name: Canberra Merry-Go-Round
objection: Rule rejects operators and rides; here the carousel is a heritage object in a fixed place, but a $3 ride is about 5 minutes.

name: Canberra Glassworks
objection: It is a working studio with a gift store, and Wikivoyage's listing is marked a dead link, so hours may be unreliable.

name: Canberra City Art Trail
objection: A trail is a route not a spot, and the installations are individually minor.

name: Tuggeranong Art Trail
objection: Same objection as the City Art Trail, plus weaker billing.

name: Captain James Cook Memorial
objection: For: two counted sources, a distinctive landmark visitors photograph at Regatta Point. Against: a memorial and a short visit, with the jet not always running; Wikivoyage Civic treats Civic memorials as not popular destinations.

name: Lake Burley Griffin
objection: Large and overlaps the institutions on its shore, but is the city's defining outing.

name: Commonwealth Park
objection: Mostly an urban park; its main fame is the Floriade festival, which is not a spot, and the lake edge is covered by other candidates.

name: Commonwealth Place
objection: A plaza and flag display is a short stop; the lake views are not unique and visitors are mainly in the Triangle for the institutions.

name: Aboriginal Tent Embassy
objection: One source, an open lawn with tents and flags; the visit may be short.

name: Australian-American Memorial
objection: Brief rules minor memorials out unless a source singles them out; Wikivoyage does single this one out as the only sight there.

name: Anzac Parade
objection: Memorials alone are minor, but the avenue is a walk guides describe.

name: Owl (Armstrong)
objection: It is a photo stop of ten minutes beside a shopping centre.

name: National Carillon
objection: Exterior and sound mainly; short visit.

name: Queen Elizabeth II Island
objection: The carillon is a tower seen from the lakeshore and recitals are on set times, so the visit is short.

name: Mount Ainslie Lookout
objection: If the list also holds Mount Ainslie Nature Reserve or a summit walk, this is a part; a lookout on a mountain track is excluded by rule 3.

name: Mount Pleasant Lookout
objection: A 10-20 minute roadside pull-out with a modest memorial; the listing has a dead link and a guide does not single it out as a headline view.

name: Mount Majura
objection: Second-tier hill beside Ainslie; walkers only.

name: Black Mountain
objection: Wikivoyage itself says 'recreation activities are limited' and it is mainly a conservation park.

name: Mount Taylor
objection: Named only once in a list sentence, with no listing of its own, so a one-source second-tier hill.

name: Red Hill Lookout
objection: Trees can block the view, per the listing itself, and the cafe is a business.

name: Oakey Hill
objection: A suburban green wedge between Weston and Lyons; one listing and a short walk.

name: Tuggeranong Hill
objection: The Wikivoyage listing is a single thin sentence and the agency page is not readable by scripts.

name: Mount Wanniassa
objection: The two sources listed are two pages of the same site, so effectively one counted source.

name: Mount Stromlo Observatory
objection: Public access mostly by evening events and a cafe/visitor centre; still a permanent place.

name: Stromlo Forest Park
objection: Low views but a recreation destination with trails open to all.

name: Australian National Botanic Gardens
objection: None of substance; its themed gardens are parts of it, not separate spots.

name: Classics Museum
objection: The collection is small and inside a university building, so a visitor from elsewhere would not go out of their way.

name: Drill Hall Gallery
objection: Rotating shows mean there is no fixed thing to see, and one source names it.

name: National Film and Sound Archive
objection: Only two sources and Wikivoyage just mentions it nearby the Shine Dome.

name: Shine Dome
objection: Seen from the street and the Academy runs public tours rarely, so it fails rule 2 as a building only seen from outside.

name: Australian Institute of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Studies
objection: It is primarily a government research institute and library, and the draw to a traveller is unclear.

name: National Museum of Australia
objection: None serious.

name: CSIRO Discovery Centre
objection: One counted source, weekday-only and small, so it could equally be review.

name: Canberra Railway Museum
objection: Volunteer-run with limited open days and hours; a niche interest.

name: Canberra Fire Museum
objection: Open one morning a week and a small volunteer museum, so it is not there whenever you arrive; one source only.

name: National Dinosaur Museum
objection: Private family attraction, closed some days.

name: Cockington Green Gardens
objection: Family-oriented and ticketed, so not for every traveller.

name: Canberra Reptile Zoo
objection: It is a commercial zoo in a strip of attractions; the Gold Creek Village precinct might be the single draw. Kept as a place with its own entry and hours.

name: Canberra Walk-in Aviary
objection: Small family attraction a few doors from the Reptile Zoo; near-duplicate precinct; one-hour visit.

name: Mulligans Flat Woodland Sanctuary
objection: Sanctuary is a reserve; twilight tours are bookable but trails are open.

name: Goorooyarroo Nature Reserve
objection: Adjoins Mulligans Flat (a bigger draw) and the note says Wikipedia only; thin visitor detail; one counted source.

name: Gossan Hill
objection: Short walk, one government list source, no distinct lookout confirmed; the lengths disagree (1.7 vs 2.5 km). Cannot open the agency page.

name: One Tree Hill Lookout
objection: It sits on the Centenary Trail, which the list may also carry; a lookout on a track. Kept because three sources single it out.

name: Hall School Museum and Heritage Centre
objection: Open Thursday mornings and Sunday afternoons only, small, one source; not there whenever you arrive.

name: Bridge to Bridge Loop
objection: It is a route around parts of Lake Burley Griffin and passes sights listed on their own (War Memorial, Parliament House), so near-duplicate of the lake; one counted source.

name: Lake Ginninderra
objection: A suburban lake that mostly locals use; one source.

name: Evatt Wetlands and Ginninderra Creek Trail
objection: Local nature trail with one source; may be part of the Lake Ginninderra area; not a headline walk.

name: John Knight Memorial Park
objection: Against: local family park. For: guide names several features.

name: Umbagong District Park Grinding Grooves
objection: Small site, one source, could be a short stop; sensitive heritage visit not obviously signposted.

name: The Big Powerful Owl
objection: Ten-minute photo stop and a single source.

name: Belconnen Arts Centre
objection: Small local arts venue; kept as a gallery with two sources.

name: Strathnairn Arts
objection: Local arts venue far from the centre.

name: Australian Institute of Sport
objection: A working training campus; the visit is mostly a paid tour and could be seen as an operator product.

name: The Pinnacle Nature Reserve
objection: Only the Wikivoyage page was confirmed; the Visit Canberra 100 things page did not mention it.

name: Shepherds Lookout
objection: One source and a short stop; a lookout pull-out.

name: Cooleman Ridge
objection: Only a name in a list, no detail of what to see; coordinates missing; one source.

name: Canberra Deep Space Communication Complex
objection: About 45 minutes from Civic, weekend-only opening, and the cafe/shop may be closed.

name: Lanyon Homestead
objection: Closed Mondays, but a permanent museum venue.

name: Mugga-Mugga Cottage
objection: Case for: three counted sources, genuine heritage house. Against: opens one weekend a month.

name: Tuggeranong Schoolhouse Museum
objection: Open only the second Sunday of the month, link dead, one source.

name: Geoscience Australia
objection: Government agency visitor centre, weekdays only, one source; a short visit.

name: Tuggeranong Arts Centre
objection: Local arts centre mostly a theatre and studios; mostly events, one dead-link listing.

name: Lake Tuggeranong
objection: Case for: a named district lake with a walk. Against: an urban amenity lake, not a trip.

name: Pine Island Reserve
objection: A small picnic reserve; a half-hour stop for most.

name: Murrumbidgee Discovery Track
objection: No Wikipedia article or coordinates; the full length is rated hard and the route may overlap other candidates.

name: Tharwa Village
objection: Small, declining village; one source and a short visit.

name: Historic Glenburn Homestead
objection: Single source; a ruin-style site in a pine forest, described in effusive language; short visit.

name: Sparrow Hill and East Kowen Forest Trails
objection: One source; a commercial plantation trail network, not a distinct landmark; Kowen Forest may be better covered by another candidate.

name: Molonglo Gorge Nature Reserve
objection: Single source; day-use gorge with a short visit.

name: Pialligo Redwood Forest
objection: Single source; a stand of trees beside the airport runway, short visit.

name: National Arboretum Canberra
objection: The lookout inside is part of this one.

name: Lindsay Pryor National Arboretum
objection: Wikivoyage itself notes poor maintenance, it is the former arboretum, and it is near-duplicate in kind to the National Arboretum; a stroll only.

name: National Zoo and Aquarium
objection: Privately owned and ticketed; accommodation (Jamala) is separate and not judged.

name: Scrivener Dam
objection: Case for: five counted sources and named by Wikivoyage. Against: a 10-minute roadside lookout beside the zoo.

name: Stromlo Cottage
objection: Wikivoyage entry dates from 2022 and gives no hours or confirmation that it is open to visit; a small suburban cottage.

name: High Court of Australia
objection: A courthouse: tours are restricted when the court sits, and it sits inside the Parliamentary Triangle precinct with the other institutions.

name: National Archives of Australia
objection: Archive-focused, lower draw than the galleries.

name: National Portrait Gallery
objection: Smaller than the NGA but a national institution.

name: National Gallery of Australia
objection: None serious.

name: National Library of Australia
objection: A library is a civic building by default; it qualifies only through the exhibitions and tours.

name: Old Parliament House
objection: None serious.

name: Questacon
objection: Family-oriented, ticketed.

name: Parliament House
objection: None serious.

name: Parliamentary Triangle
objection: Case for: a guide frames it as one walk. Against: duplicates its member institutions.

name: Australian War Memorial
objection: None worth noting; a possible duplicate with Anzac Parade as a place, but it is a distinct institution.

name: Royal Australian Mint
objection: None serious.

name: Calthorpes' House
objection: Open only weekends afternoons; small house; the part-of signal came from the three-house pass but each house is a separate place.

name: Blundells Cottage
objection: Small, a 30-minute visit with weekend-only hours.

name: National Capital Exhibition
objection: Small indoor exhibition near the visitors centre; short visit.

name: Manuka Pool
objection: Open only late October to mid-March; one source; essentially a local pool.

name: Kingston Powerhouse
objection: Partly a workshop/shop, and Wikivoyage entry is flagged a dead link; some may see it as a business.

name: Jerrabomberra Wetlands
objection: Flat and modest, an hour at most; mostly of interest to birders.

name: Yarralumla Bay
objection: One source, thin description, no coordinates, may be a local foreshore.

name: Craft and Design Canberra
objection: Contemporary craft gallery and shop; short visit, little draw beyond Glassworks.

name: Gallery of Small Things
objection: Wikivoyage calls it an art shop; limited hours, far north suburb.

name: Weston Park
objection: Local district park; kept because two guides single it out.

name: Kings Park
objection: Mostly minor memorials; a park of lawns beside Commonwealth Park; one source.

name: Canberra Centenary Trail
objection: Very long linear route; sections overlap candidate hills and reserves.

name: Red Rocks Gorge
objection: One agency source; the walk may overlap Murrumbidgee River Corridor candidates; climbing closed.

name: Majura Pines
objection: One source, an activity venue in a plantation, overlap with Treetops/Majura area.

name: Changi Chapel
objection: Short visit, one source repeated across two pages, sits inside Royal Military College grounds where most buildings are restricted; may be part of a Duntroon visit rather than a draw.

name: Royal Military College, Duntroon
objection: Against: working military college, restricted buildings, one source. For: open grounds, a named chapel.

name: Duntroon Dairy
objection: Exterior view of about 15 minutes with one source; keeping adds a minor heritage stop. Against: no interior access.

name: St John the Baptist Church, Reid
objection: A short stop and it is a church; keep depends on the schoolhouse museum being open.

name: Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve
objection: Overlaps with its many walk candidates, which I reject as parts of it; it is a feature/area but clearly a place to go.

name: Birrigai Time Trail
objection: Against: one source, inside Tidbinbilla (already kept), and Wikivoyage's own claim of 'world's oldest inhabited rock shelter' is unverified. For: it is the reserve's one cultural-heritage visit and a guide singles it out.

name: Gibraltar Peak
objection: It is a hard walk inside Tidbinbilla and may be judged part of the reserve; but peaks named by a source are kept per the run rule.

name: Honeysuckle Creek Tracking Station
objection: Not much of the station remains (the dish was moved), so it is mostly signage; single counted source.

name: Orroral Valley Tracking Station
objection: For: a space-history stop in the same valley as Orroral Homestead. Against: ruins with little to see, one source, short visit.

name: Corin Forest
objection: It is a private commercial resort with a lodge; entry is paid and the snow is seasonal. The script flagged it as an operator.

name: Gibraltar Falls
objection: It lies within Namadgi and the waterfall flow is seasonal.

name: Namadgi National Park
objection: Huge; individual walks may be candidates separately.

name: Australian Alps Walking Track
objection: Not a place with one visit; most of the 640 km is in NSW/Vic and the ACT stretch is a remote leg through Namadgi.

name: Booroomba Rocks
objection: Short, steep walk inside a park that already has many walks; modest page views.

name: Mount Gingera
objection: Long full-day walk with one agency mention and no guide write-up; Wikivoyage does not list it.

name: Mount Franklin (Australian Capital Territory)
objection: Case for: named summit walk with historic shelter. Against: remote, one thin source I could read, part of Namadgi National Park.

name: Bimberi Peak
objection: Remote wilderness, no day-trip access; the entry is a single line.

name: Yankee Hat
objection: One source, small site; the rock art is a short walk from the car park.

name: Settlers Track
objection: One agency source; overlaps with the homesteads that Wikivoyage lists.

name: Orroral Valley Circuit
objection: A full-day loop passing the homestead and tracking station, which are separate stops; one source.

name: Ginini Flats Wetlands Ramsar Site
objection: Reached only by high-country tracks; one line of description and little to see beyond the walk.

name: Hospital Hill Lookout
objection: Against: roadside pull-out, one source. For: a guide names it.

name: Gudgenby Homestead
objection: Small timber hut; one source; brief visit.

name: Orroral Homestead
objection: Small hut; one source; easy short stop.

name: Bendora Dam
objection: Remote and a single source; a dam wall viewed from a lookout.

name: Corin Dam
objection: Empty listing; the area is better sourced as Corin Forest, an operator.

name: Cotter Dam
objection: Mostly a water-supply dam; sourcing is thin and recreation is mostly the Cotter picnic areas.

name: Bendora Arboretum
objection: Wikivoyage itself calls it isolated and desolate, a 90-minute drive, so few visitors.

name: Cotter Reserve
objection: An area with campground, avenue and bend as parts; Casuarina Sands overlaps.

name: Casuarina Sands
objection: Basically a picnic ground; one source.

name: Point Hut Crossing
objection: A local picnic and walking stop; one source.

name: Uriarra Crossing
objection: Local picnic area; one source.

name: Kambah Pool
objection: Local swimming hole; river access can be rough.

name: Jerrabomberra West Grasslands
objection: Single agency source, long walk of about three hours, limited access via Callum Brae.

name: Centenary Trail
objection: A 145 km loop is not a half-hour visit; arguably several sections.

name: Hall
objection: Wikivoyage itself says Hall 'may not have much to see'; a short stop mostly for the heritage walk and cafes.

name: Tharwa
objection: Small declining village; the visit is half an hour of wandering.

name: Mugga-Mugga
objection: Against: not there whenever you arrive, one source, small. For: real heritage site with tours.

name: Geoscience Australia Education Centre
objection: Against: government agency foyer, niche. For: free, weekday daily, something to see.

name: Mount Ainslie
objection: Overlaps Red Hill/Black Mountain as city lookouts; the walking tracks are part of it.

name: Red Hill Nature Reserve
objection: Local reserve; lookout alone is a short stop.

name: Black Mountain Nature Reserve
objection: Overlaps with Black Mountain Tower if listed separately.

name: Aranda Bushland Nature Reserve
objection: Against: suburban bushland, one source, no guide singles it out. For: agency-named walk.

name: Molonglo River Reserve
objection: Against: unspecific, one source. For: a named reserve with tracks.

name: Tharwa Sandwash
objection: Against: picnic area, one source. For: agency-named riverside stop near Tharwa.

name: Blue Range Hut
objection: For: historic hut the agency names. Against: little to see, one source.

name: Tuggeranong Pines
objection: For: used for mountain biking and walking. Against: a plantation, one source.

name: Canberra Nara Peace Park
objection: Against: small, one source, a garden inside a district park. For: distinct themed garden.

name: Canberra Beijing Garden
objection: Against: small, one source, near-neighbour of Nara Peace Park. For: distinct garden.
